notes.title: Our First Public Demo
notes.notes: [p]Hello, we're the fish devs and we have an announcement! 🫧🐠[/p][p][/p][p]We'll be showcasing our first public demo for 🌊The Edge of Water🌊 at [b]Devcom Developer Conference[/b] in Germany. If you're in [b]Cologne[/b] during [b]17-19 August[/b], you can be among the first people to try out our game and give us feedback![/p][p][/p][p]So far, we've posted snippets and shenanigans on social media, but we are now ready to present a fuller view of the world and story of The Edge of Water. We want this demo to capture the atmosphere and beauty we wish to convey throughout the whole game. [/p][p][/p][p]And so we've been working hard and making many changes. We now have a new model for our main character, we've improved movement and controls, and we're handcrafting a beautiful environment that will hold hints of lore and will allow you to meet some of our sea creatures! [/p][p][/p][p]We hope to meet some of you at devcom! Until then, you can follow us on 🦋[url="https://web-cdn.bsky.app/profile/bigmoodgames.bsky.social"]Bluesky [/url]to see more updates![/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]The BigMood Team 🐙🎩[/p][p][/p]
